title: Missing 5-Year-Old Boy Found Buried in Massachusetts Park
description:
Five-year-old Elijah Lewis seemingly vanished from his New Hampshire home in September 2021 without a trace. His mother, Danielle Dauphinais, and her boyfriend, Joe Stapf, had a child together only a few weeks after Lewis' disappearance. When investigators found Elijah buried in a Massachusetts State park, they knew the truth of his disappearance was much more sinister. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.

Danielle and Joe stick to their stories, but it's later revealed that five-year-old Elijah
was found dead in that shallow grave with fentanyl in his system after the New Hampshire mom
allegedly recruited her boyfriend to help dump the body. Investigators estimate the child
died between September 21st and September 24th, 2021. Danielle ultimately pleaded guilty to second
degree murder and two counts of tampering with a witness. She was sentenced to 53 years behind
bars. Joseph pleaded guilty to manslaughter, second-degree assault, falsifying physical evidence,
and witness tampering in connection to the boy's death. He was sentenced to 22 to 45 years behind
bars.
